title: Comprehensible Japanese — Upper Intermediate: 日本のポップカルチャー (Japanese Pop Culture)
description: From Comprehensible Japanese. Upper-intermediate episode delivered entirely in natural Japanese at a pace comfortable for N2 learners. Covers the global spread of anime, manga, and J-pop — why they resonated abroad, how fandom communities formed, and how the industry changed. Richer vocabulary and more complex clause structures than the Intermediate episode.
